corrections.old_text: ን ነውና ኽለ ። አብ ዝንቱ ው↵
corrections.corrected_text: ን ነውና አለ ። አብ ዝንቱ ው↵
corrections.reason: Ink smudge on top of አ caused it to be misread as ኽ; standard Amharic quotative verb 'አለ' (he said).
6th-order ሳድስ 'ሽ' in 'የሚያሽከረክሩ' (matching line 20 below), misread as 1st-order 'ሸ'.
Classical Ge'ez verb with 3rd person masculine plural object suffix is 'ወባረኮሙ' (7th-order ሳብዕ 'ኮ', 'and He blessed them'), visually confirmed by the shortened right leg of ኮ.
